title: RI has one of the most haunted roads in the world
excerpt: Halloween is right around the corner and Rhode Islanders don't have to look far to find one of the most haunted roads in the world.
content:
CUMBERLAND, R.I. (WPRI) — Halloween is right around the corner and Rhode Islanders don't have to look far to find one of the most haunted roads in the world.

Tower Hill Road in Cumberland is ninth on the list from car rental agency SIXT.

"Drivers have reported seeing ghostly children on tricycles, a mysterious Lady in White, and even a Bigfoot-like creature known as the 'man monkey.' With reports of strange shadows, footsteps, and unsettling encounters after dark, Tower Hill Road offers plenty of chills for those brave enough to take the drive at night," the website reads.

Coming in at number one is Clinton Road in New Jersey, where drivers pass Dead Man's Curve and may even encounter the infamous Jersey Devil.

SIXT said it used TikTok and Google search trends for its study.
